text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Mozambican government has announced an increase in the price of petrol to 6,790 from 6,700 meticais, but kerosine prices went down to 2,850 from 3,540 meticais. Diesel and jet fuel users will also pay less.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton named career diplomat Brian Curren as the new ambassador to Mozambique. Curren has worked in U.S. embassies in Belgium, France and Ireland.
